text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... And that's a wrap for the beach run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp has
begun. This is our chance to
really level up
and gain some skills that'll pay off on
the track, but
just as we're getting started...

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: Ines? Is that really you, Ines?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: N-no way! Sandman?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep! He lived in my neighborhood back
home. Last I heard, he
moved. What a
small world!

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Small world, indeed! I knew you went to
Tracen Academy, but I never
thought I'd
meet you here, of all places!

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm runnin' the beach cafe over there now.
Come drop by later!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You bet we will!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After training, we head to the beach cafe.
But...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Looks like they're really,
really busy.

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ines!
I'd love to catch up—we're just a
bit swamped at the
moment!

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
It's not usually like this, but the summer
festival season brings in a
stampede of
folks, you see...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Gotcha...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, is it that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure it doesn't interfere with
training, so can I please—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I want you to come help too!
Pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Heeere you go! Two jumbo yakisoba—hot
off the griddle!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Here's your grilled carrot and tropical
drink! Enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! I'd like to order!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I still haven't gotten my Blue
Hawaii!

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hey, kiddo, how you holdin' up? Kinda
seems like you're a li'l green
for this gig.

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hey, kiddo, how you holdin' up? Kinda
seems like you're a li'l green
for this gig.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nooo problem!
I get you're a little worried,
but just you watch.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It might not look like it,
but my trainer's
super dependable when it
counts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't let her down. No ifs, ands,
or buts.
With renewed resolve, I
head back to the
kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time marches on, and before I know it, the
day of the summer festival
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that was quick! Thank you very
much!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that was quick! Thank you very
much!

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Gotta say, I had my doubts at first, but
you're a real pro now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heheh! I told you so! ♪

text_block_list.name: Beachside Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't have done it without you two.
I'll
handle the rest, so go
enjoy the festival!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Nothing beats a good honeyade
after a hard day's work! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer! Thanks for agreeing to
help out!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... The old me probably would have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Not gonna lie, I would've assumed having
you there would do more
harm than good.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! But it's different now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You might seem a little clumsy, but when
push comes to shove, you
always deliver!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I figured it wouldn't hurt to
rely
on you a bit this time.
Turned out to be a
good idea, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, when we first met,
I didn't think
I could count on you for
anything. But look
at you now! What changed?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! The whole sky's
sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Y'know... if I'd been the only one helping
out, I'd probably be too
burnt out to enjoy
the fireworks or this festival.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to a certain someone, I can
enjoy these events to my
heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I just wanna say...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I came to the academy. I'm glad I
came to the summer camp.
And... I'm really
glad I met you!

text_block_list.name: Bandaged Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If I knew it would end like this...
I wish I
had never met you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what's with that frown? If you're
happy, then smile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rather than happiness, it feels like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders. I'm now more certain than ever—I want to be her trainer. I will help her soar.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pft!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez! You gotta nail lines like that,
y'know!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Giggling playfully, she looks my way, and
her warm gaze flutters my
heart.
